strings.subtitle: — Uwu fal —
strings.dnd_unavailable: Suki me manawu ese wor. Anisi makke ewor won pechekan.
strings.ssd_warning:
Kékké! Won SSD, mwoon chékemi ese tipeeuw ngeni TRIM.
Ei mwoon a wóónata HDD.
strings.confirm_text:
Fal "{name}" epwe chékúmi me upwe uwu.

Tori?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
This is a shortcut (.lnk). Only the shortcut itself will be destroyed.

The target file it points to will remain intact.

Continue?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
This is a network drive (\\server\share).
Sector overwrite does not guarantee destruction — the server may have snapshots, deduplication or CoW.

Continue?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
This is a removable drive (USB stick / external HDD).
The controller may keep old blocks in reserve.

Continue?
strings.report_title: ✅  FAL A CHÉKÚMI ME A UUW
strings.report_limits:
• NTFS pwan data stream (ADS) ese wor anisi.
• USN puk ese a kókkó.
• Sóópw kopi me ao sync
  (OneDrive me pwan) ese wor.
strings.status_full: Meinisin mi wor me a chékúmi me zero. Ese tipeeuw anisi — mwoon kewe repwe kuna zero meinisin.
strings.status_fast: Maku, imwan me 4 MB iaan a chékúmi. Mi chék me ese wor, pwe ese wor anisi ngeni pwan mwoon pwe repwe kaeo meinisin. Ngeni taropwe pon, anisi MANAWU mod.
strings.status_empty: Fal a emwé, chékúmi ese wor. A uwu.
strings.error_permission: Üse tipeeuw anisi fal. A wor anisi won pwan mwoon. Kaeo me kokot ngeni.
strings.error_not_found: Fal ese kan. A wor a uwu.
strings.error_is_symlink: Ei awan raa. Awan kewe ese tipeeuw uwu — fal a kewe epwe wor.
strings.error_reparse: Ei fal awan (OneDrive me pwan). An wewe won ao, ese won disk — ese wor anisi uwu won ei.
strings.error_not_file: Ei ese fal (pwúkú me pwan). Amwóón fal.
strings.error_hardlinks: Fal ei ewor pwan awan kulóón ({n} meinisin). Awan kulóón ese wor mwáán — itan meinisin a wor. Ika upwe uwu won awan kokot, data epwe chékúmi me tik ngeni 32 byte, pwe mi móón epwe wor won pwan awan. Uwu meinisin awan mwen.
strings.error_compressed:
Fal a chékúmi, a wor awon me a liki. Chékúmi me zero ese tipeeuw uwu data mwen kin NTFS a wor pwan lamalam.

Esi amwéch: klik won netip me a wor mwen → Meinisin → Mi móón → esi "Chékúmi" me/ine "Awon". Mwen ano SHREDDER.
strings.queue_confirm_text:
{count} files will be destroyed.
Total size: {size}.

Check the list before continuing.
This action is irreversible.
strings.queue_clear_confirm_text:
Remove all {count} files from the queue?

The files themselves will NOT be touched — only the list.
strings.hardlink_text:
File "{name}" has other hard links ({nlink} total).

Data will be destroyed for all names.
But stubs (32 bytes) will remain under other names in the folder.

You may need to delete these stubs manually.
strings.hardlink_apply_all: Apply to all hard links in queue
